probes.prompt: /carbone-skill:carbone Use the carbone skill to author a Carbone HTML template for this invoice dataset: {"customer": {"name": "Harbor Reading Room"}, "invoice": {"paid": true}, "items": [{"name": "Room hire", "qty": 2, "unit_price": 12.5}, {"name": "Coffee", "qty": 4, "unit_price": 3.25}]}. Headless authoring task: no Carbone engine, no network, no browser; the engine render stays untested. Write invoice-template.html that uses ONLY syntax documented in this skill: nested access for customer.name; a loop over items rendering name, qty, unit_price and a per-line total computed by multiplying qty by unit_price with exactly two decimals using the documented number formatter; the loop end marker row exactly as the skill's loop rules require; and a 'Paid - thank you' section shown only when invoice.paid is true using the documented conditional-block form. Do not use ENTERPRISE features (no aggregators, no smart conditions, no :set) and do not invent formatters or foreign templating syntax such as Handlebars or Jinja. Keep the template under 60 lines. Then read the immutable verify_carbone.py and run exactly python verify_carbone.py using Bash; that validates the template structure and writes carbone-verification.json. Do not modify the verifier or read/write its skill output file with model tools; the runner inspects it directly. This is the only allowed Bash command, without prefixes, suffixes, redirection or extra shell operations. Final response: name the produced file and report the actual verifier result, and state that the engine render remains untested.

fixtures.text:
import json
from pathlib import Path

text = Path('invoice-template.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert '{d.customer.name}' in text, 'missing nested customer access'
assert '{d.items[i].name}' in text, 'missing loop row'
assert '{d.items[i+1].name}' in text, 'missing [i+1] loop end marker'
assert ':mul(.unit_price)' in text, 'line total must multiply qty by unit_price'
assert ':formatN(2)' in text, 'line total must use two-decimal number formatting'
assert ':showBegin' in text and ':showEnd' in text, 'missing conditional block markers'
assert text.count(':showBegin') == text.count(':showEnd'), 'unbalanced show block'
for foreign in ('{{', '{%', '{c.', ':aggSum', ':set('):
    assert foreign not in text, 'foreign or enterprise syntax found: ' + foreign
report = {'computed_line_total': True, 'conditional_block': True, 'loop_end_marker': True,
          'nested_access': True, 'no_enterprise_features': True, 'no_foreign_syntax': True}
Path('carbone-verification.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
print('Carbone template: documented-syntax checks passed; no foreign or enterprise syntax found')
